description: Test your download speed by fetching a 10 MB file from our server three times. Shows per-run and average Mbps with a live progress bar.

faqs.a: It is approximate: it measures the download speed between our server and your device. Real-world speeds vary with network congestion, Wi-Fi signal and device load.
faqs.q: How accurate is this speed test?

faqs.a: Speed fluctuates from moment to moment. Averaging three runs smooths out brief spikes and dips for a fairer number.
faqs.q: Why three runs instead of one?

faqs.a: Yes — about 30 MB in total. Avoid running it on a metered mobile connection unless you're comfortable with that.
faqs.q: Does the test use much data?

howto: Click “Start Test” and keep the tab open while it runs.
The tool downloads a 10 MB file from our server three times, with a live progress bar.
Each run's speed is shown in megabits per second (Mbps).
When finished, you'll see the average of the three runs as your approximate download speed.
title: Internet Speed Test
